notes.title: Update to version 1.1
notes.content:
We just released a new update for Pirate's Life.

Version 1.1:
- Added an autosave feature. The autosave and it's interval can be set in the options menu.
- Added a new checkbox "allow carriers" to the raid window. Unchecking the box will stop the game from spawning new carriers as long as the raid window is open. This should help with the assignment of crew members for raids.
- Maximum amount of gold storage is now recalculated correctly after loading a game
- Fixed a crash when trying to load an empty saveslot when english localization is active
- Fixed a crash when trying to build multiple treasure chambers while holding down Shift
- Several smaller fixes


Additional Notes:
The last update seems to have helped those of you who experienced a crash after the initial language selection as we have not received any more reports of this happening.

Still it seems like the game does not start on the computers of some players. If you experience this issue please check your XNA and .NET Framework installations. Also take a look at the game's error log file to see if the XNA installation could be detected correctly.

notes.title: Update to version 1.01
notes.content:
Hi folks,
we just pushed a new update to Steam:

Version 1.01
- Save slots which are not used at the moment are now correctly localized
- Fixed a bug where it was possible to load an empty save slot, resulting in a crash
- Added error logging to disk. This should help in tracking down the issues encountered by some people where the game is not starting or crashing after the intial language selection.

We know it is a rather small update, but it is a start in ironing out some of the issues that were reported to us.

You can find the log file at:
{YourSteamDirectory}\SteamApps\common\PiratesLife\ErrorLog.log

If you experience any crashes or issues when starting the game please check this file and attach it's contents to your bug report.
